pages.rationale: The decision tree, cost table, guarantee limits, and switching procedure serve distinct purposes. Outbox versus immutable and future dual-write behavior are different conditions. No repeated same-source term-meaning benefit is present; repeated mode identifiers and summaries are necessary navigation.

The layouts have different ownership, row cardinality, cleanup, and verification rules. Similar deletion or coverage wording applies to distinct target configurations. Representation and distance metric are independent choices. No same-source definition benefit is repeated.

The overview table and per-mode sections have separate reference functions. Shared-capture cleanup, reader lifetime, union of watched fields, and retire versus abandon add distinct constraints. Repeated descriptions of declaration versus enforcement and report visibility remain scoped to different modes; no shared glossary meaning invariant is asserted.
